name: SWE-fficiency
intro: SWE-fficiency 评测编码智能体能否在真实工作负载上优化代码库性能，同时保持现有行为。它从 9 个数据科学、机器学习和 HPC Python 仓库中挖掘 498 个专家性能 PR，经关键词/AST 过滤、动态覆盖与静态符号解析、人工工作负载标注和受控执行验证；模型补丁须通过覆盖单元测试，再以相对专家加速效果的 Speedup Ratio 评分。
org: Harvard University, Google DeepMind, Princeton University, Xi'an Jiaotong University
build_method: 性能 PR 挖掘、覆盖测试定位、人工工作负载标注、受控执行过滤
task_type: 代码优化, 性能工程
eval_feature: 真实工作负载、正确性约束、专家归一化性能评分
scale: 498 个性能优化任务，9 个 Python 仓库
build_method_en: Performance-PR Mining, Covering-Test Localization, Manual Workload Annotation, Controlled Execution Filtering
eval_feature_en: Real Workloads, Correctness Constraints, Expert-Normalized Performance Scoring
intro_en: SWE-fficiency evaluates whether coding agents can optimize repository performance on real workloads while preserving existing behavior. It mines 498 expert performance pull requests from nine data-science, machine-learning, and HPC Python repositories, then applies keyword/AST filtering, dynamic coverage plus static symbol resolution, manual workload annotation, and controlled execution. Model patches must pass covering unit tests and are scored by Speedup Ratio relative to the expert optimization.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.06090 Section 2.1 and the evaluation metric definition. The diagram preserves all five stages: nine-repository PR mining; performance-keyword, no-test-change, and meaningful-AST filtering; covering-test discovery with pinned Docker, coverage.py, and static symbol resolution; manual performance-workload annotation; and controlled execution with resource pinning. Retained tasks require significant improvement above two measurement standard deviations and less than 0.5 percent SR drift, while evaluation requires covering tests to pass and aggregates expert-normalized Speedup Ratio with a harmonic mean.
